# gitea_package_versions (Data Source)

Lists all versions of a package.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_package_versions" "example" {
  owner        = "my-org"
  package_type = "generic"
  name         = "my-package"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The package name.
- `owner` (String) The package owner.
- `package_type` (String) The package type.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `versions` (List of Object) All discovered versions for the package. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))
